test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

PRIZES : RPZISE :: CAUGHT : ?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

PRIZES : RPZISE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ec6934bbbc5827a8ae6f569d5dc6a9a99b3646cd4a04756254ce8a979d86048.png] 

Similarly,

CAUGHT : ACGTUH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71394348fb270db33ef5f12672992437ea24249d2315ab03fd6f3ed2e0895f21.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"ACGTUH".**
